overview.about: The VidantaWorld Mexico Open is Mexico's national open and a full PGA Tour event, played at the Vidanta resort near Puerto Vallarta on the Pacific coast. It brings a genuine Tour title to Mexico in a warm, resort-golf setting.
overview.nextEvent: The next VidantaWorld Mexico Open is played at the Vidanta course in Nuevo Vallarta. As Mexico's national championship on the PGA Tour, it pairs elite golf with a Pacific-coast holiday backdrop.
